title: Module E - CT Injection System Orientation (non-operational)
reviewStatus: PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW - orientation statements only. This module does not teach operation, programming or dosing of any device.

questions.prompt: What is a CT injection system used for?
options: Delivering contrast media in a controlled way during CT imaging
questions.hint: The name says what it injects, and it is used alongside a scanner.
questions.explanation: It is a powered device that delivers contrast media during CT imaging. In real practice only trained, authorised staff operate it.

questions.prompt: Does this simulator teach you to operate the injector or set doses?
options: No, it is an orientation model only
Yes, but only the dosing part
questions.hint: Look at the label on the model: it is a visual teaching model.
questions.explanation: The model is for orientation only. Operation requires approved manufacturer training and local protocol.

questions.prompt: Where should injection settings in a real department come from?
options: A colleague's memory of last time
The approved local protocol and the manufacturer's instructions
questions.explanation: Settings follow approved local protocol and the manufacturer's instructions, as directed by the responsible clinician.

questions.prompt: Which general check belongs in safe practice before any contrast-related procedure?
options: Confirming the patient's identity and the order against local protocol
questions.explanation: Confirming patient identity and the order before starting is a basic safety check in every department.

questions.prompt: Why is air in an injection line a concern?
options: It makes the line look untidy
It can enter the bloodstream and cause serious harm, so lines are prepared and checked per protocol
It only affects the colour of the image
questions.hint: Think about what happens if air reaches the patient.
questions.explanation: Air entering the circulation can cause serious harm, which is why lines are prepared and checked following protocol.

questions.prompt: Who may operate a CT injector in a real hospital?
options: Only staff trained and authorised for that device
questions.explanation: Only staff who are trained and authorised for the specific device operate it.
